[US-POL-15] Hartwell US overtime for field roles
Non-exempt field employees are paid one and a half times their regular rate for hours over 40 in a workweek, and where state law requires it, for daily overtime. Supervisors approve overtime in advance in the crew schedule.

[AU-EA-01] Hartwell Australia enterprise agreement, overtime and weekend rates
For employees covered by the enterprise agreement, Saturday work is paid at time and a half for the first 2 hours and double time after that. Sunday work is paid at double time and public holidays at double time and a half.

[US-REW-09] Setting a starting rate for a new field hire, Hartwell US
Set the starting rate from the posted range for the role and state. An offer above the midpoint of the range needs the Field Operations HR lead's approval. Bargaining-unit roles follow the wage schedule in the local agreement.

[UK-POL-14] Hartwell UK overtime and weekend working, field and facilities staff
Overtime for field and facilities staff is paid at time and a half on weekdays and Saturdays and at double time on Sundays and bank holidays. Overtime must be agreed with the line manager in advance and recorded in the timesheet.

Question: What overtime rate applies when my team works on a Sunday?

content.text: {"answer": "The Sunday rate depends on where your team works. In Australia, for employees covered by the enterprise agreement, Sunday work is paid at double time. In the UK, overtime for field and facilities staff is paid at double time on Sundays. The US sources do not give a Sunday-specific rate. For US field roles, overtime is one and a half times the regular rate for hours over 40 in a workweek, and daily overtime applies where state law requires it.", "sources": ["AU-EA-01", "UK-POL-14", "US-POL-15"], "route": false}
